copy.headline: “We need to be compensated”: Texas Tech chair pushed Fermi data center company for lucrative deals
copy.caption: Records show Texas Tech Board Chair Cody Campbell pressed Fermi’s former CEO to give him a controlling role and a contract for his oil and gas company worth millions of dollars in stock options.

story.title: “We need to be compensated”: Texas Tech chair pushed Fermi data center company for lucrative deals, despite university ties
story.summary: Records show Texas Tech Board Chair Cody Campbell pressed Fermi’s former CEO to give him a controlling role and a contract for his oil and gas company worth millions of dollars in stock options. Tech holds Fermi’s land lease.
